source_findings.preservation: Keep CSV and useful agreed image-ROI interchange. RFC section 4 recognizes prior arrangements for alternative CRS; this scoped result does not show QuPath-to-QuPath exchange is unusable. Distinguish an agreed pixel-coordinate profile from unrestricted RFC interoperability.
source_findings.reason: Revision section 4.3 explicitly uses pixel coordinates and a descriptive property. RFC sections 4/7.1 retain geographic coordinate semantics; foreign members do not redefine them. QuPath documents pixel ROI interchange but that use does not establish generic RFC-conforming geographic semantics.
